verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents its own visual workflow builder for multi-step automations from drag-and-drop blocks, plus shareable templates and reusable automations. Repeat runs are cached as deterministic Playwright code, and agents can be scheduled, so repeatable multi-step workflows beyond one-shot prompts are clearly supported. Missing for 10: any evidence of loop blocks, conditional/branching logic, or workflow input parameters, and independent hands-on corroboration of workflow composition.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can compose repeatable multi-step workflows with loops, conditionals, and parameters instead of one-shot prompts

citations.quote: Build multi-step automations visually in the Cloud UI with drag-and-drop blocks. No code required. Share templates across your team.
Browser recorder that converts manual actions into reusable automations
Generated Playwright code is cached after the first run. Repeat runs skip the LLM entirely — 3–5× faster, up to 70% cheaper, fully deterministic.
It builds an agent you can test, edit in Studio, schedule and share. No code.
Browser Automation is the code-first way to build multi-step automations.
